jsonld_raw.name: (150 G) CEDAR WOOD SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle. Contains vegetable wax.

Cedar wood. The scents of the traditional pharmacy, floral, woody, and sweet, merge to give rise to a collection of modern and current fragrances. Citrus and floral, discover the woody base notes subtly sweetened by a hint of sugar cane.

Aromatic notes:
Top notes: citrus, mandarin, grapefruit
Heart notes: floral, freesia, jasmine
Base notes: aromatic, cedar wood, sugar cane
